articles.headline: NBA championship and Finals MVP odds: Thunder remain title favorites heading into Game 7 vs. Spurs
articles.description: Game 7 is set for Saturday in Oklahoma City, with the Thunder-Spurs winner playing the Eastern Conference champion Knicks in the NBA Finals.

images.name: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander [1296x729]
images.caption: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and Victor Wembanyama are Nos. 1 and 2 in the Finals MVP odds, respectively.

images.name: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander [608x342]
images.caption: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and the Thunder are back to being odds-on title favorites after taking a 3-2 series lead over the Spurs.
images.alt: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander

images.name: Jalen Brunson [608x342]
images.caption: Jalen Brunson has the New York Knicks in the NBA Finals for the first time since 1999.
images.alt: Jalen Brunson

images.name: Knicks/Cavs [1296x729]
images.caption: The Knicks are looking to end the series against the Cavaliers tonight, as they have the second-shortest title odds and are an overwhelming favorite to win the East.
images.alt: New York Knicks guard Landry Shamet (L) defends Cleveland Cavaliers guard Donovan Mitchell (R) during game 3 of the NBA East Conference Finals between the Cleveland Cavaliers and the New York Knicks in Cleveland, Ohio, USA, 23 May 2026.

images.caption: The Knicks are now heavy favorites to win the Eastern Conference after taking a 3-0 series lead over the Cavs.
images.alt: Jalen Brunson
images.credit: Nathaniel S. Butler/NBAE via Getty Images

article.headline: Dwight Howard scores 22, grabs 10 boards in Rockets win
article.description: Howard scores 22, Rockets beat T-Wolves in Mexico
article.linkText: Howard powers Rockets by Wolves in Mexico
article.story: MEXICO CITY -- Feeling better after missing his first game of the season because of a flu-like virus, Dwight Howard promised to put on a show for his Mexican fans. And he delivered. Howard, who missed Saturday's game against the Golden State Warriors, had 22 points and 10 rebounds Wednesday as the Houston Rockets beat the Minnesota Timberwolves 113-101 at Arena Ciudad de Mexico in the first regular-season game played south of the border since 1997. "It's a big honor to play in Mexico. We had an amazing time even though it was a super short trip. The last time we lost so I wanted to come back with a better effort," said Howard, who fed off the 18,996 fans. "I've always wanted to come to Mexico. The fans were great. They were standing and cheering from warm-ups until the end ... I wish I could play all of our games here in Mexico." James Harden led the Rockets with 23 points and a team-high 10 assists, but was only 8 of 23 from the field. Trevor Ariza added 19 points and Kostas Papanikolau scored a career-high 14 for the Rockets (7-1), who tied Memphis for the best record in the Western Conference. "We want to be the best at the end of the year," Howard said. "The West is a tough Conference, but if we play hard, we can beat anybody. We want to hold the trophy at the end of the year. That's what we talk about every day." With Ricky Rubio sidelined indefinitely after spraining his left ankle during Friday's loss to the Orlando Magic, the Wolves lost their third straight game. Corey Brewer scored 18 points and rookie Andrew Wiggins added 15 for Minnesota. The Rockets played without starting point guard Patrick Beverley and couldn't pull away until the third quarter. "In the first half it was tough. We couldn't get any stops," Harden said. "In the third quarter we locked down and made a run to seal the game then." The teams played without incident nearly a year after a game between the San Antonio Spurs and Timberwolves was canceled because a short circuit in a generator room sent smoke and fumes inside the Mexico City Arena during warmups. --- TIP-INS Timberwolves: After hitting 46.2 percent from the field in their first three games, Minnesota shot under 45 percent (44.4) from the field for the fifth straight night. ... The Wolves turned the ball over 13 times. Rockets: After going 0 for 6 from beyond the arc in the loss against the Warriors, Ariza nailed three 3-pointers. ... The Rockets defense, which held opponents under 100 points in their first seven games of the season, allowed more than 100 for the first time. UP NEXT Timberwolves: At New Orleans on Friday. Rockets: Hosts Philadelphia on Friday. "MEXICAN" ROCKETS Houston played in Mexico City for the sixth time in their history. The Rockets played the first ever NBA game south of the border in the 1992 preseason. Also, Houston played in the first regular season in Mexico when they defeated Dallas 108-106 in 1997. Their overall record in Mexican soil is now 4-2.
